# Complimentary Injury Screenings

## You don’t have to put up with pain.

Whether you’ve recently sprained an ankle, strained your shoulder or have been living with a soreness don’t wait! Take advantage of a complimentary injury screen (free consultation) at any of our locations.

_By scheduling a complimentary injury screen, you can meet one of our expert clinicians to learn more about your current aches and pains and see if treatment is the best next step for you._

Anything keeping you from functioning 100% deserves attention. During your screening, our team with examine your movement patterns, listen to your concerns and work with to you determine what’s next. We are the medical field’s experts in musculoskeletal movement and we will work with you and your physician of choice to help you get better, faster.

We _listen_ because we _care_. There is no follow-up obligation with this visit– _you_ make the decision about _your_ care, and we hope you choose us!
